ndjson.label: TERMINAL HEALTH: the idle cross-wire switch and the post-switch claude turn surface no ACP error.
SWITCH LANDED: the ACP session/set_model round-trip completed (the runner synthesizes acp_set_model on a successful response; a refusal would have surfaced acp_error + FAIL).
TURN CENSUS: exactly four completed turns (3 qwen + 1 claude) — no dropped turn, no retry-terminated extra turn.

artifact.label: NO COMPACT (corrected expectation): no compaction request artifact — the family-switch compact gate requires is_family_switch (model_switch.rs:155-174) and the claude-sonnet-5 row is family-unset, so the gate never fires for qwen->claude; a presence = a compact ran -> the ride-along pins below are vacuous and the catalog/gate changed -> investigate.
NO COMPACT (checkpoint twin): no compaction checkpoint artifact for the same reason; a presence = the history was replaced by a summary.

SWITCH-TIME PROJECTION RAN (XW-PROJECT-1): the shell emitted shell.turn.switch_projection_persisted for the idle model-id change — the cross-wire seam is projection-owned, not compact-owned (switch_projection.rs).

T1 STORE RE-KEY: the persisted history carries xw_-rekeyed reasoning ids — the Vertex-boundary switch projection re-keyed the foreign qwen reasoning items at switch time (projection.rs T1; the re-key is a STORE fact, it does not ride the /messages wire).

OWN SIGNED THINKING MINTED: the post-switch claude turn persisted its OWN signed thinking (encrypted_content present in the store) — the thinking SURFACE continues by minting its own signatures, never by riding foreign ones.

wire.label: CONTROL (anti-vacuous pin): a pre-switch qwen request carried a reasoning INPUT item — real foreign reasoning existed to cross the switch. Without this the ride-along/suppression pins are vacuous.

STORE=FALSE INVARIANT: the qwen responses wire ran store=false (the hermetic-home dogfood contract; reasoning items are NOT persisted upstream — the Azure 'items are not persisted when store is false' class).
NO RETRY STORM: exactly one claude request expected (200 direct on the portable transcript); 2 = one tolerated reactive retry; >=3 = storm -> defect.
USER TEXT RIDE-ALONG: the post-switch claude request replays the pre-switch user prompt verbatim — the portable text transcript survives the cross-wire switch.
ASSISTANT TEXT RIDE-ALONG: the pre-switch qwen assistant reply text rides verbatim into the claude request.

R8 SUPPRESSION (the messages-side net): the first claude request carries NO foreign thinking block — R8 model-identity suppression (messages.rs: the owning qwen assistant's model_id != the claude request slug) drops the foreign reasoning pre-send; a presence = the signed-thinking invariant is exposed on the wire.
NO XW_ RIDES ON /messages: the T1 xw_ re-key lives in the STORE only; the /messages wire has no reasoning-item site, so re-keyed ids must not leak onto the wire.
NO FOREIGN CIPHERTEXT: zero encrypted_content on the first claude request (the key substring covers both JSON spacing variants) — foreign signatures never ride.
POST-SWITCH ACCEPTED: the final claude request reached 200 — the cross-wire contract holds on the portable transcript.

SIGNED THINKING RESUMES: the claude post-switch response stream carries a thinking CONTENT BLOCK (regex on the JSON-escaped SSE frame text; T21 hand-escape precedent) — the thinking surface continues on the claude side. The store-side twin is store_claude_sig.
SW-A VERDICT RECORD: last-captured wire response status line, verbatim (machine-readable). recon op — always records, never fails.
